Documentation

Documentation: everything explained, with pictures

How we build your website, what you pay, what your client area looks like and what you see in your dashboard. The screenshots are examples, with made-up figures.

1How it works2Lia and Alex3The creation questionnaire4The websites5The price6The client area7Requesting a change8Lia Tokens and the tools9The dashboard10The online shop11SEO12Payment and loyalty

1. How it works

From order to launch

  1. You build your website online. Type of website, domain name, options: the total price is shown before you order.
  2. You pay a 25% deposit. That is the starting signal: I begin building.
  3. You fill in the creation questionnaire. In your client area: colours, feel, photos, prices or products. This is what starts the creation.
  4. I build your website. You follow each step in the “My order” tab of your client area.
  5. You receive your website and pay the rest. In one go, or in 6 or 12 interest-free instalments.
  6. Your subscription starts. Hosting, security, updates and the month’s changes: we take care of everything.

Build my website

2. Lia and Alex

Two to look after your website

Lia, the AI

She makes small and medium changes in 5 minutes, and writes your social media posts. She always shows a preview: nothing changes without your approval.

Alex, the human

He creates your website, makes the big changes by hand, checks and answers your questions. Whatever Lia cannot do goes to him.

Pourquoi Alex & Lia My method with AI

3. The creation questionnaire

What I need from you to create your website

4. The websites

Three types of website, one price

One page or a showcase website: the build price is the same, and it does not change along the way. The online shop adds €200. The timeframe starts once I have your text and photos.

One-page website€5003 to 5 days

To be online without any fuss: everything fits on one page that you scroll.

Showcase website€5001 to 2 weeks

To present a business in detail, with one page per topic and a menu.

Online shop€500 + €2002 to 3 weeks

To sell online: card payment, order tracking, and the shop tools.

See our clients’ websites

5. The price

A website, a subscription, and your options

There is only one offer, the same for every client. You pay for your website once. After that, the subscription keeps it going: it is required, and you can stop it whenever you like from your client area.

The website€500Once

One page, or a showcase website up to five pages. With an online shop: €700.

The subscription€10Per month, no commitment

It starts when you receive the website. Yearly: €100, which is 2 months free.

Options and extrasYour choiceNever required

Options are paid once, with the website. Extras are paid monthly, and stop whenever you like.

What the subscription includes

  • Domain name linked to your website and renewed every year, in your name
  • Hosting on a quality server
  • HTTPS: the little padlock that protects your visitors
  • Updates done for you, and backups
  • Monitoring: the website is watched, and it holds up when it gets busy
  • Support: a question, a reply within 72 hours
  • Contact form that lands in your inbox
  • Bases du référencement : Google sait lire et comprendre votre site
  • Petites retouches avec Lia, mon assistante : un horaire, un prix, une photo
  • Une intervention d’Alex par trimestre, faite et vérifiée à la main
  • Votre espace client : demandes, outils pour vous faire connaître, suivi
  • No commitment: stop whenever you like

6. The client area

Your whole website, in one place

Each client has their own area, on computer and on phone. All the tabs are visible at once, with no scrolling.

  • Dashboard: your visitors and the state of your website, at a glance.
  • Home: your subscription, your website, your latest activity.
  • My order: tracking the build of your website, step by step.
  • My requests: you write what needs changing, and you follow its progress.
  • My shop: discount codes, sales, banner and holiday mode (online shops).
  • Referral: your code to share, and the free months you have earned.
  • My account: your details, your password, your subscription, your extras and your invoices.

The “My shop” tab only appears for online shops.

Try the demo

7. Requesting a change

You write, Lia or Alex handles it

For each request, you choose who does it:

  • Lia, the AI, makes small and medium changes in 5 minutes, on a single page. She shows you the preview, and changes nothing without your approval.
  • Alex makes the bigger ones, by hand. If a request is too big for Lia, it goes to Alex.
  • A request can be cancelled free of charge within 24 hours, 3 times a month.
  • Vos Jetons Lia et vos interventions d’Alex (une intervention par trimestre) sont affichés en haut de votre espace.
  • Besoin de plus ? Un article, un point avec Alex ou une demande sous 24 heures se commandent à l’unité, dans le même onglet.

9. The dashboard

The simple dashboard, and the full dashboard

The simple dashboard is included in the subscription. The full dashboard comes with the “Detailed figures” extra, at €5 a month. Visits are counted without cookies and without personal data. The figures update every hour.

Included in the subscription: the essentials

With the Detailed figures extra: all the detail

  • Status lights: website online, HTTPS padlock, speed, server, disk space. Green means all is well.
  • Sources: Google, direct visits, social media or other websites.
  • Server: your website’s memory, the server load and disk space, shown as gauges.

10. The online shop

Your sales tools, set up in seconds

In the “My shop” tab, you manage your small promotions yourself. They do not count towards your changes for the month.

  • Discount codesIn % or in €, or free delivery. End date, minimum order, number of uses: it is all set in one form.
  • Quick salesFrom -5 to -70% on the whole shop or one category. Crossed-out prices appear on their own and disappear on the end date.
  • Announcement bannerA sentence at the top of the website, in a choice of four colours.
  • Holiday modeShop closed, or orders accepted with shipping on your return. A preview shows what your visitors will see.

12. Payment and loyalty

Pay simply, and get a thank you

  • A 25% deposit when you order, the rest when you receive the website, in one go or in 6 or 12 interest-free instalments.
  • Subscription paid monthly, or yearly with 2 months free. No commitment.
  • Referral: when a referred friend’s website is online, you each get 1 month of subscription free.
  • A second website: 10% off its build.
